leads.title: Assessing the Performance of Fuel Cell Electric Vehicles Using Synthetic Hydrogen Fuel
leads.reported_scope: Real vehicle refuelling and hydrogen-quality experiments; the article compares HRS metering with mass inferred from vehicle-tank pressure and temperature.
eligible_use: HRS meter versus vehicle-tank cross-check design
next_access_request: synchronized timestamped HRS flow and vehicle pressure/temperature trace
vehicle tank geometry and calibration uncertainty
leads.claim_limit: The published study supports a vehicle-side measurement and mass-accounting lead. It does not by itself establish a public synchronized raw trace or complete station-controller validation.

leads.reported_scope: Open-access 2026 HRS sampling study comparing representative sampling arrangements; the reported flow context includes FCEV or large-tank sampling and smaller-tank sampling, but it is not a station-controller or full refuelling trace release.
